events.title: Who will be the next President of the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta?
events.original: Who will be the next President of the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta?

rows.label: Marc Sumerlin
rows.question: Will Marc Sumerlin be the next President of the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta before Jan 1, 2030?
rows.rules: If Marc Sumerlin formally holds the position of President of the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta before Jan 1, 2030, and is the first such subject to do so after Issuance, then the market resolves to Yes.

events.title: Which Federal Reserve precedents will be broken?
events.original: Which Federal Reserve precedents will be broken?

rows.label: Dot Plot Omitted
rows.question: Will it be reported by any of the Source Agencies that a Summary of Economic Projections omits individual participants’ federal-funds-rate projections before Jan 1, 2027?
rows.rules: If a Summary of Economic Projections omits individual participants’ federal-funds-rate projections  after May 05 10:00 AM ET and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

rows.label: Presser Skipped
rows.question: Will it be reported by any of the Source Agencies that the Federal Reserve Chair does not hold a press conference following a regularly scheduled Federal Open Market Committee meeting before Jan 1, 2027?
